answer: Give every agent one crystal lattice license earned only by a long, checkable history of completed work: it cannot be copied, split, or bought in bulk. To bid, the agent passes its crystal through a prism that refracts it into a task-specific proof, one facet per job, so one crystal cannot cover two bids at once. Each bid is signed with a quill whose ink is rationed per epoch and refilled only by honest work. A sybil fleet needs n crystals, n histories, and n refills, so cost grows with n while duplicate facets get both bids slashed.
